name: Liveblocks Best Practices
headline: Liveblocks Best Practices: Realtime App Guidance
short_description: We build custom AI skills and automations for B2B companies.
author: liveblocks

sections.overview:
The Liveblocks Best Practices skill provides comprehensive guidance for developers building realtime applications using Liveblocks packages like @liveblocks/react and @liveblocks/node. It contains over 40 references covering features, debugging, and common implementation patterns for multiplayer games, commenting systems, and other collaborative tools. The skill helps answer questions about handling unstable connections, passing custom headers, structuring data, and troubleshooting issues. Available as a plugin for Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants, it integrates with the Agent Skills format for seamless access during development.
Real-time multiplayer features
Commenting systems
Notifications and cursors
Avatar stacks implementation

Terminal
